title: Great Hangers!
text: Great Hangers!. A few months ago, I started replacing all of my plastic hangers with slim velvet ones. These are comparable to others that I have ordered. They take up less space in the closet. Clothes stay on the hangers and don't slide off easily. There's no visible branding on these to identify them as Kenneth Cole Reaction.

product_metadata.title: KENNETH COLE 30 Pack Velvet Hangers for Shirts, Suits, Pants, Dresses, Sweaters, Jackets, Coats, Belts, Jeans for Men/Women - Space Saving, Non Slip, 360 Hook, Slim, Flocked, Shoulder Notch (Black)
features: Stainless Steel Construction: Kenneth Cole REACTION stainless steel hangers are strong enough to hold heavy garments. The contour shoulders prevent wide neck clothes from slipping off the huggable hanger. Each hanger is strong enough to carry over 15 pounds of weight!
Non-slip Technology: The non-slip and supremely soft luxurious velvet material holds the clothes without falling or sagging and leaves no crease on your clothing.

Closet Space Saver: Each hanger is only 0.2 " thick. The perfect closet storage organizing solution for Ties, Blazers and scarves. All of your clothing can be hung on the central crossbar, ultra thin design maximizes the storage and keep items organized. Perfect for suit jacket, suit pants, sweaters, jeans, button downs, dress shirts, jackets, coats, heavy garments.
Dimensions: 9.2" x 17.4" x 0.2" Weight: Each hanger weighs 0.2 LBs
Secure Packaging: These Hangers are safely packaged so there will be no damage, dirt, defective or breakage with your delivery.
